title: ci(dxf): declarative catalog gates with evidence-backed quarantine records (DXF-CATALOG-GATE-001)
intent: Step 3 of the owner's DXF order (2026-09-14). Both DXF catalog gates (DXF Validation Gate = app/ci/check_dxf_files.py; DXF Asset Validation = scripts/validate_dxf_assets.py) now judge every catalog file against the contract of its asset class, declared in one registry (app/ci/dxf_catalog_registry.json) and read through one policy module (app/ci/dxf_catalog_policy.py). Implements the owner rulings: export-readiness semantics with no warning downgrade; folder + layer classification declared, not coded; BODY_POINTS reference layer; WIRING_CHANNEL not declared valid; stored catalog DXFs R12 only (R2000 is bucket-1 paid-tier canonical vectorizer output); quarantine records with the required fields, owner stream DXF Catalog Integrity, manufacturing authority BLOCKED; complexity under 15 with no baseline raised.
behavior_change: Both catalog gates change verdicts. Before: the Files gate ran main's old logic (80 pass / 15 fail after #372) and the asset gate failed 76 of 95 on an R12-R2000 + closed-LWPOLYLINE-only rule. After: 95 files -> 65 PASS, 30 QUARANTINED, 0 FAIL in both gates. QUARANTINED means the file fails exactly the clauses its registry record declares; any other failure, a healed clause (stale record), an unclassified catalog file or a record for a missing file fails the gate. New failing conditions that did not exist before: stored R2000/R2010 files (R12-only policy), an outline-layer closed contour that does not bound its layer, chained outlines that cross themselves, and preflight/topology crashes (previously a warning). No runtime or export behaviour changes: only CI gate code, the registry and tests. Per-file JSON results replace the old passed field with blocks_gate and export_ready (no in-repo consumer reads either gate's JSON).

diff_articulation.what_changed: New app/ci/dxf_catalog_policy.py (classification, version clause, closed_outline via pruned edge-graph components with 0.05 mm snap and layer-extent coverage, quarantine judging; stdlib + ezdxf entity attributes only, no numpy-backed helpers). New app/ci/dxf_catalog_registry.json (classes, contracts, outline/reference layers with evidence, R12-only version policy with its sources, 30 quarantine records generated from the gate's own output plus traced evidence). check_dxf_files.py rewritten around a clause table (preflight/topology on the manufacturing view with reference layers removed; chained-outline crossing check; crash = failure); main() complexity 29 -> 11 and its complexity-baseline entry removed (violation_count 274 -> 273). validate_dxf_assets.py rewritten on the same policy (ezdxf-only clauses; false bounds-vs-spec claim removed from its docstring). Both workflows trigger on the policy module and registry. New test file (34 tests). The audit doc from ci/dxf-gate-repair-001 lands with a correction header; a new classification note records every rule's resolution and what the gate does not check. Review hardening (third commit): registry schema v2 validated at load by the new app/ci/dxf_catalog_schema.py (required keys and types, clause set == implemented clauses, class/rule/record consistency, dispositions, BLOCKED authority, owner stream, gate evidence lines covering exactly failed_contract, sha256 pin); per-segment class globs with an error on ambiguous classification; closed chains must be simple cycles (rejects pinched figure-8s and chords); records pinned to asset_sha256; a crashing clause fails that file instead of the run; registry catalog_root checked against the scanned root; the asset gate imports the policy as a package; tests split into test_dxf_catalog_gate.py and test_dxf_catalog_registry.py (500-line limit). Second review round (fourth commit): the manufacturing view is serialized from a fresh parse so ctx.doc is never mutated (a registry ordering closed_outline after preflight used to crash on destroyed entities); an unimplemented contract clause fails instead of passing; files are hashed only when a quarantine record exists and an unreadable recorded file fails instead of crashing the run; results carry blocks_gate/export_ready instead of an ambiguous passed; the Files gate JSON regains summary counts and a --report option, which makes the workflow's existing upload-on-failure step real; the asset_class override is keyword-only. test_jumbo_dimension_consistency.py acknowledges the registry: its canonical-magnitude hits were substrings of asset_sha256 digests, which made the jumbo namespace scan fail API Tests / api-verify / Core CI Summary on acb7fde6.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No existing manifest covers these paths; the #372 manifest covered only the topology validator fix and its test. The LINE-loop recognition idea comes from the reverted Copilot repair (df2f6876..e9ffd088 on ci/dxf-gate-repair-001) but is reimplemented here (component-based, bounded by layer coverage) and every warning downgrade from that repair is rejected, per the audit.
